title: World Mosquito Day 2026: Europe must upgrade control tools as disease risks rise
summary: Europe needs to improve its preparedness and control efforts as the risk of mosquito-borne diseases increases, with West Nile virus (WNV) continuing to spread to new regions and invasive mosquito species becoming established in more parts of Europe.

title: Epidemiological update – 11 August 2026: Imported case of Andes hantavirus in the EU/EEA
summary: On 6 August 2026, French public health authorities reported an imported case of Andes hantavirus infection in a traveller from Argentina.

title: Chikungunya virus disease worldwide overview
summary: Every month ECDC provides detailed epidemiological overview of the worldwide transmission of chikungunya virus disease in its weekly threat report (Communicable Diseases Threat Report).
